title: Carry the resolved pin in study briefs; exempt it from the hash rule
summary: Studies' producer and verifier briefs get a "Pinned source" section with the pin Athena resolved (url, ref, full SHA), taken from the job record's PinnedRepo. The "never pin or cite a commit hash" rule is reworded so it still bars verification-made hashes but explicitly allows the pinned instance's SHA.

defaults_applied.how: Add unit tests for the pin section and the reworded rule; cargo test and clippy must pass.
One focused change to brief rendering and its call site.
Recovered the target (VERIFIER_VISIBILITY and pin_repo) from the repository.

assumptions: 'Study briefs' means the producer and verifier briefs of a job whose capability pins a repository (job.pin is Some); reader briefs are unchanged.
The exemption applies only to the SHA Athena resolved and put in the brief; hashes made during verification remain forbidden.
The pin is rendered from the existing PinnedRepo record; no new pinning logic.

acceptance_criteria.text: ProducerInputs and VerifierInputs in crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs gain an optional pin (athena_data PinnedRepo: url, ref, sha); producer_brief and verifier_brief render a 'Pinned source' section with all three values only when it is set, and omit it otherwise.
crates/athena-core/src/run.rs passes the pin resolved by pin_repo into the producer brief (and into the verifier inputs), so the brief carries the real resolved SHA, never a placeholder.

The VERIFIER_VISIBILITY text no longer forbids citing the pinned SHA: it still bars hashes made during verification, but states that the pinned instance's url, ref and SHA from the brief must be cited as given.
New unit tests in briefs.rs show a brief with a pin contains the url, ref and full SHA and the exemption wording, and a brief without a pin has no pin section. Run: cargo test -p athena-context.
Existing tests (including the one asserting the hash rule wording) are updated and pass, and the core's study pin tests still pass. Run: cargo test, cargo clippy --all-targets, cargo fmt --check.

out_of_scope: Changing how Athena resolves or validates pins (pin.rs).
departures: Slightly higher cost than reference because the change spans two crates and updates several tests.
